verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is itself an official SDK. Its docs describe it as components you add to web or mobile applications. The official aws/amazon-chime-sdk-js GitHub repo documents creating meeting and messaging sessions in client apps, with official demos and a test suite. Missing for 10: specific evidence of the mobile (iOS/Android) or server-side SDKs, API reference depth, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Amazon Chime SDK is a set of real-time communications components that you can use to quickly add messaging, audio, video, and screen sharing capabilities to your web or mobile applications.
Create a meeting session in your client application.
Create a messaging session in your client application to receive messages from Amazon Chime SDK for Messaging.
